title: DIY Jiji Cat Bag: Easy Sewing 🐾 Easy Step-by-Step Tutorial  #diybag #jiji #sewingtutorial
description:
Sew your own adorable Jiji cat bag from "Kiki's Delivery Service" with me! 🎀 In this easy tutorial, I'll show you how to make this plush anime-inspired bag at home using simple materials and basic sewing steps. Perfect for beginners! I'm using black Sherpa fabric for that fluffy lamb look

▶️ Full video step-by-step tutorial is here https://youtu.be/IlqZRgH0Ir8

✂️ Materials used ✂️
🔹 Black abd grey plush fabric (Sherpa/Faux fur)
🔹 White felt for details
🔹 Red thread for nose hand stitching
🔹 Adjustable strap & zipper
